title.narrative: Local Endeavors for HIV/AIDS Prevention and Treatment (LEAP) Activity

description.narrative: The goal of the Local Endeavors for HIV/AIDS Prevention and Treatment (LEAP) activity is to prevent new HIV infections in targeted populations, particularly sex workers at high risk of HIV infection.
